1. Static Analysis

Programming Languages / Other

  • tern — A JavaScript code analyzer for deep, cross-editor language support.
  • Frink — A Tcl formatting and static check program (can prettify the program, minimise, obfuscate or just sanity check it).

Multiple languages / Other

  • CodeQue (⭐158) — Ecosystem for structural matching JavaScript and TypeScript code. Offers search tool that understands code structure. Available as CLI tool and Visual Studio Code extension. It helps to search code faster and more accurately making you workflow more effective. Soon it will offer ESLint plugin to create your own rules in minutes to help with assuring codebase quality.
  • SonarQube for IDE — SonarQube for IDE (formerly SonarLint) is a free IDE extension available for IntelliJ, VS Code, Visual Studio, and Eclipse, to find and fix coding issues in real-time, flagging issues as you code, just like a spell-checker. More than a linter, it also delivers rich contextual guidance to help developers understand why there is an issue, assess the risk, and educate them on how to fix it.
  • Code Intelligence ⚠️ ©️ — CI/CD-agnostic DevSecOps platform which combines industry-leading fuzzing engines for finding bugs and visualizing code coverage

6. Awesome Gemini Cli

Agent Orchestration & CLI Tools

  • MAO - Native desktop canvas for macOS, Windows and Linux that runs Gemini CLI (0.41 or later) as a built-in agent alongside Claude Code, Codex, Grok, OpenCode, Antigravity and shell agents, each as a real terminal node on its own login. Wired agents hand each other tasks through the mao CLI, an Orchestrator agent can recruit and direct the others, and each layer is a git worktree whose diff you review and land from the canvas. Closed source; US$20 one-time, 7-day free trial.

Commands & Extensions

  • Recommerce (⭐10) - Agent Skills (SKILL.md) for second-hand purchases: compare listings, assemble kits, inspect items, plan collection, weigh keep vs. repair vs. replace, and recheck before committing. Read-only, no API key, never contacts sellers or buys. MIT. Install with npx skills add budna-marketplace/recommerce -y -a gemini-cli.

Development Tools & Utilities

  • Scarwise (⭐0) - Gemini CLI hooks (BeforeTool/AfterTool) that learn from failed tool calls by themselves and stop a known mistake before it runs; what one agent learns protects your other agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode and more).
  • self-host (⭐5) - Lets your agent install self-hosted apps on your own hardware and set them up (admin accounts, API keys, apps connected to each other), asking before each step.
  • Agent Notifications (⭐822) - Cross-platform desktop notifications and optional webhooks for Gemini CLI turn completion and tool permission requests. Also supports Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, Cursor CLI, and Qoder.

Education & Study Tools

  • codecall (⭐16) - Agent Skill that runs in Gemini CLI and other agents (npx skills add GAURAV-1313/codecall). Quizzes you on the code your agent just wrote, traces one request flow file by file, or plants one bug for a debugging-interview drill and restores it with Git. No API key.

MCP Servers

  • Carbon Forge - Hosted MCP server for source control and a shared record: Gemini CLI can read and write code, files and prose in one record on the server, open a lane instead of cloning, and land a change as one all-or-nothing changeset. Remote Streamable HTTP at https://carbonforge.dev/api/mcp; public workspaces read without a token, writing needs a bearer token.
  • Tera Studio - Hosted MCP server for singers over remote Streamable HTTP, no key or sign-in: find_song_key looks up a well-known song's key, tempo and typical vocal range by title, and the other tools return links to free browser tools that find a song file's key and BPM or move it up to 6 semitones. Add with gemini mcp add --transport http tera-studio https://terastudio.co/mcp.
  • MCP Probe Kit (⭐41) - Diagnostics and self-test toolkit for MCP servers: enumerates every tool, resource and prompt, exercises them, and reports health, latency and schema drift between runs. Read-only against the target server, so you can point it at any server you connect Gemini CLI to and see what it actually exposes. MIT, npx -y mcp-probe-kit, official MCP Registry io.github.mybolide/mcp-probe-kit.
  • Coding Tools MCP (⭐435) - Desktop MCP workspace for coding agents: file edits, command execution, Git status and resumable history sessions behind one local stdio interface, so Gemini CLI gets project scaffolding and code search without four separate servers. Apache-2.0, official MCP Registry io.github.mybolide/coding-tools-mcp.
  • Budna MCP (⭐3) - Read-only MCP server for Budna, a Swedish second-hand marketplace: search and inspect public listings, categories, filters, seller profiles, and bid and rating summaries from Gemini CLI. 11 tools, interactive listing cards in MCP Apps clients. Local stdio, no API key, no account. MIT. Run with npx --yes @budna-marketplace/mcp.
  • BankBridge - Hosted MCP server that lets Gemini CLI answer questions about your own US bank, credit card and investment accounts: spending by category or merchant, recurring charges, monthly cashflow, holdings. 12 read-only tools, data fetched live on each call; it can't move money. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in. Paid, $5/mo per connected bank. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/bankbridge-money/bankbridge-plugin, then /mcp auth bankbridge.
  • Tavero (⭐3) - MCP server and CLI that finds UI inconsistencies (spacing, colors, typography, component drift) in running React apps and gives coding agents fixes with file/line references. Works with Gemini CLI as an MCP server. Run: npx -y tavero mcp. Free, MIT.

🎬 Video (30) / ✏️ Text (19)

Utilities / General Tools

1. Awesome Testing

Software / Service Virtualization

  • MockForge (⭐12) - Open-source API mock server written in Rust for HTTP/OpenAPI, gRPC, GraphQL, WebSocket, Kafka, MQTT and AMQP, with data generation and latency/fault injection.
  • Twinbay - Hosted, stateful twins of third-party APIs such as Shopify, Slack, Zendesk and QuickBooks for integration and AI agent tests. Each test run gets a private URL, and directives force states like rate limits or failed payments.
  • fieldtwin - Open-source, local, stateful twins of the Jobber and QuickBooks Online APIs for integration and AI agent tests, with checkpoints, rewind, and faults on demand.
  • OutageFence (⭐0) - Local HTTP fault-injection CLI by Slanta Cause that checks synthetic sensitive data against declared destination rules, with positive controls and offline reports.

Software / UI & End-to-End Testing

  • Device Hub Pro (⭐136) - Free, open-source macOS app for manual testing on Android emulators, Android phones and iOS simulators side by side, with live mirroring, device controls (network, location, permissions, deep links, push), logs, screenshots and screen recordings.
  • ai-wright (⭐1) - Open-source library that adds AI action, assertion, and data extraction steps to Playwright tests, using annotated screenshots and your own OpenAI, Gemini, or Claude API key.
  • App Crash Lab (⭐3) - MIT-licensed Node 22+/Playwright CLI that checks saved web-app values after reload and rejected updates, exporting state diffs and standalone Playwright tests.
  • blastproof - Open-source AI agent that runs plain-English e2e tests in a real browser. It reads the pull request diff, runs only the tests for the pages that changed and can block the merge on a score. Runs locally or in CI with your own LLM key.
  • Browser Use (⭐118k) - Open-source (MIT) Python AI agent that runs plain-English tasks in a real browser. Browser Use Cloud adds hosted stealth Chromium you can drive over CDP from Playwright, Puppeteer or Selenium, with session recordings and live view.
  • cloudf.one - Rent a real Samsung Android phone in Singapore on a Singtel or M1 SIM and use it from a browser tab, to check how an app behaves for Singapore users. Manual use only, no Appium or scripts.
  • Clousd - Cloud Android phones (150+ device models, Android 12-17) for app testing in a browser tab, over ADB, or through a REST API and MCP server for AI-driven tests.
  • ContextQA MCP - Hosted MCP server for creating and running end-to-end tests and investigating failures, with OAuth browser sign-in.
  • Drengr - Mobile tests written as plain-English tasks instead of selectors, driven by an agent on real Android devices and iOS simulators. Works where there is no accessibility tree — canvas, games, Flutter without semantics labels — by falling back to vision and coordinates. Runs locally or in CI; bring your own model key.
  • Drengr Runner (⭐1) - Drive an iOS simulator over HTTP from any language. A 479-line Swift XCTest target replacing WebDriverAgent on simulators. Apache-2.0.
  • Proxy QA Browser (⭐1) - Free, open-source desktop app to test your own web forms by US location, emulated device and browser, with recorded scenarios, consent and accessibility checks, and a CI runner.
  • vibe-testing (⭐17) - Open-source MCP server and CLI that scans web app routes and forms, runs browser checks with Playwright, and produces HTML QA reports.
  • VibeView - Run & test iOS, Android, Apple TV and Android TV apps right in your browser, with Roku in beta. Build tests by recording a flow or write steps in plain English, flows can be ran cross-platform, and wired into pull requests. When a step fails - AI agent takes over so the rest of the run still completes, and the report tells you what changed based on failed steps and visual diff.
  • assay (⭐108) - Deterministic command-line QA tool that serves a local web page, drives every control it finds in Chromium through Playwright. No tests to write and no LLM, with a Python API, an HTML report, and a plugin for AI coding agent. MIT, Python.
  • Device Changer - Applies device models, build fingerprints and identifiers to rooted Android test devices to reproduce device-specific bugs.

Software / Accessibility & Usability Testing

  • Oh My Android (⭐73) - Free, open-source macOS app for checking Android apps on emulators and phones in dark mode, large font sizes, RTL and TalkBack, with a TalkBack-order accessibility audit.
  • A11yKit - 15 free client-side web accessibility and WCAG 2.2 color contrast testing tools with zero code uploads.
  • AuditReady - Runs 12 deterministic HTML checks on a page against WCAG 2.2 and returns the matching criterion and a suggested fix for each finding, then turns them into a printable report an agency can hand to its client. Free instant scan; the full report is a one-off $29.
  • Barbwire - Sends AI buyer personas built from your site through the live pages in a real browser, and reports where each one would stop buying, with a step-by-step replay, screenshots and fixes ranked worst first. 10 free runs, no card; paid plans from €49/month.
  • RateMyApp Testing Brief Builder - Free, no-account tool for writing mobile usability-testing tasks, expected outcomes, and feedback instructions.
  • Site Spell Checker - Crawls a live website and flags spelling and grammar mistakes on every page, each shown in context with its page URL. Free one-page scan; the full-site scan is a one-off $99.

Software / API Testing

  • SolidPing (⭐26) - Open-source (AGPL-3.0) uptime and API monitoring with a free hosted tier. Runs HTTP, gRPC, WebSocket and custom JS checks on a schedule and alerts when an endpoint fails.
  • API Spector - Open-source API clien, mock server and contract testing tool. Zero telemetry.
  • Openhook (⭐1) - Open-source webhook inbox for capturing callbacks and inspecting request headers and bodies through a browser, REST API, or MCP.
  • BestJSON JSON Diff - Free browser tool for comparing saved JSON API responses by structure, with explicit array-order and record-ID matching rules.
  • Kerno - The AI Backend Runtime QA Engineer. Runs locally inside your coding agent's loop through MCP and tests each change against your running app and its real databases, queues and services.
  • OpenAPI Breaking Change Checker - Free browser tool that compares two Swagger 2.0 or OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 descriptions (JSON or YAML) and sorts each change into likely breaking, review-needed or compatible; the files stay in the browser.

Software / Security Testing

  • Darkmoon (⭐1.1k) - Open-source (GPLv3) autonomous AI penetration-testing CLI with 50 specialist agents and 140+ offensive tools over MCP for DAST-style web and API security assessment.

Software / AI & LLM Testing

  • geokit-cli (⭐0) - Open-source CLI for automated AI search engine readiness testing, /llms.txt validation, and crawler access audits.
  • aiexpect (⭐2) - Python assertions for non-deterministic AI text that drop into pytest. Semantic and rule checks work offline; optional LLM judge with your own model; produces a Trust Score and a single-file HTML report.
  • OrcaReplay (⭐281) - Records a coding-agent session below the harness, keeping the verbatim request and response bytes, then replays the same run offline with the network off or forks it from a checkpoint onto other models with a verify command deciding the verdict.

1. Awesome Raspberry Pi

Projects

  • Coffee Edition (⭐0) - A two-page newspaper printed every morning by a Raspberry Pi Pico W or Pico 2 W, written overnight by a Claude Code routine, checked by GitHub Actions and streamed to a network printer over IPP.
  • Bad Thing of the Edge (⭐45) - Mechanical gaming keyboard for the left hand, built around a Raspberry Pi Pico.
  • Cannvas (⭐4) - Family touchscreen dashboard for a portrait TV with an infrared touch frame, with whiteboards, chores, calendar and Home Assistant controls, running on a Raspberry Pi 4 Model B.
  • Clock/Calendar Retrofit (⭐10) - Retrofits a broken electronic clock/calendar with a Raspberry Pi Pico W, synced over Wi-Fi via NTP.
  • MeshSat (⭐93) - Off-grid messaging gateway that bridges Meshtastic LoRa, Iridium satellite, cellular SMS, APRS, ZigBee and BLE over a Reticulum routing layer, running as a Docker container on a Raspberry Pi.
  • Raspberry Pi TV Simulator (⭐59) - Simulates a channel change with random video playback on an old tube TV, switching between static noise and composite video.
  • Tiny Film Camera (⭐18) - Open-source digital camera with physical controls, film-inspired looks, a 3D-printed enclosure, and a phone-friendly gallery. Supports Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W.
  • VoxRT - On-device voice AI SDKs for Raspberry Pi, offering wake-word detection, VAD, keyword spotting, and streaming ASR, with a 100 KB wake-word model that runs at 5.3% CPU sustained on a Pi Zero 2 W.

Tools

  • nook (⭐0) - Turns a Pi into a shared folder and a network drive on your tailnet, both driven from another machine over SSH, with the disk offered over iSCSI or NBD.
  • piscout (⭐2) - Windows desktop app that scans the LAN for Raspberry Pis, opens an SSH terminal and remote desktop, shows temperature and load of several Pis, uploads files by drag and drop, and flashes SD cards.

Useful Apps / Android

  • Mobile SSH - SSH, SFTP, port-forwarding and multi-session terminal client for managing Raspberry Pis. Android, iOS beta.

2. Game Datasets

API

  • unicum.gg - World of Tanks player, clan, tank and map statistics across EU, NA and Asia, free and with no key. Website.

Dataset / Web

3. Awesome Appium

Test Frameworks

4. Awesome Webgl

Articles / Firefox Specific Tools/Debugger

  • Building a Browser Solar System Explorer with NASA Data and Raw WebGL2 - Engineering case study on rendering the Space Simulator Online 3D Solar System, Milky Way, and 6,000+ NASA exoplanets at 60 FPS using raw WebGL 2 shaders without Three.js.

5. Open Source Flutter Apps

Productivity

  • Daily You - A private daily journal with moods, photos and Markdown notes, stored on your device with no account. (Source (⭐1.4k))
  • LocalMind - Chat with AI models offline on your phone or through your own Ollama or LM Studio server. (Source (⭐271))
  • StoryPad - A private diary app with a timeline, mood tags, photos, a PIN or biometric lock and optional Google Drive sync. (Source (⭐971))
  • Table Habit - Habit tracker with growth-curve scores, local storage and WebDAV sync, for Android, iOS and desktop. (Source (⭐1.7k))

Finance

  • Cake Wallet - A non-custodial wallet for Monero, Bitcoin, Ethereum and more, on iOS, Android, macOS, Windows and Linux. (Source (⭐2k))
  • Fingrom - An ad-free personal finance app with multi-currency accounts, budgets and encrypted sync across devices. (Source (⭐137))
  • Invoice Ninja Admin Portal - Invoice Ninja's app for quotes, invoices, payments and time tracking on mobile, desktop and web. (Source (⭐1.8k))
  • Oinkoin - Offline, ad-free expense tracker for Android, Windows and Linux with budgets, charts and biometric lock. (Source (⭐476))
  • Peercoin Flutter - Self-custodial Peercoin wallet for Android, iOS and the web, with seed phrase backup and testnet. (Source (⭐32))
  • Sossoldi - A net worth and personal finance tracker for expenses, income and investments, on mobile, desktop and web. (Source (⭐1.4k))
  • Waterfly III - An unofficial Android app for Firefly III to track accounts, budgets and bills from your phone. (Source (⭐727))

Tools

  • API Dash - A cross-platform API client for testing web APIs, with code generation for 20+ languages. (Source (⭐2.9k))
  • Brethap - A breathing and meditation timer with custom breathing patterns, tones, vibration and a session log. (Source (⭐86))
  • Glim - A free Mac file viewer for Markdown, PDFs, images, JSON, CSV and code in one workspace. (Source (⭐17))
  • Onion Browser - Private web browser for iPhone and iPad that routes your browsing through the Tor network. (Source (⭐2.7k))
  • ServerBox - Monitor and manage your servers over SSH with live charts, a terminal and SFTP, on phone and desktop. (Source (⭐8.8k))

Developer Tools

  • iSH - Run a Linux shell and command-line tools on your iPhone and iPad. (Source (⭐21k))
  • Local Codex & Claude Analytics Ledger - See your Codex and Claude Code sessions, token usage and API-equivalent cost on a local dashboard. (Source (⭐2))

Communication

Health and Fitness

  • Medito - Free meditation app for Android and iOS with guided sessions and courses, and no ads, sign-up or paywall. (Source (⭐1.3k))

Business

  • Flutter POS System - An offline point-of-sale app for small restaurants and shops, with menus, orders, stock and receipt printing. (Source (⭐620))

Media

  • Kodi - A free home theater and media center that plays and organizes your video and music on almost any device. (Source (⭐21k))

Entertainment

  • ATV Bilibili - An unofficial Bilibili video client for Apple TV, built around the tvOS remote and focus interface. (Source (⭐3.2k))

Social Network

  • Ice Cubes - A fast Mastodon app for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Vision Pro that works with any instance. (Source (⭐7.1k))

Shopping

  • Label StoreMax - A ready-made Android and iOS shopping app template for WooCommerce stores. (Source (⭐713))

News and Magazine

  • Bardkit (⭐0) - A sample-free plucked-string instrument for multiplayer games, with a four-voice pool and per-listener distance gain.

Packages / Utilities

  • Audio Browser Lab (⭐0) - Reproduce and diagnose browser audio playback, seeking, codec, and lifecycle bugs with shareable evidence.

Packages / Apps

  • Database Inside a Song - Splits a stereo WAV, reconstructs its side channel, and visualizes the 18 kHz and 20 kHz carriers holding a byte-exact SQLite database.
  • Tonecrafted Progressions - Free browser chord-progression player and ear-training tool for guitarists, no signup.
  • Key Kalimba Github (⭐10) - Interactive 17-key Kalimba trainer, falling notes visualizer, and real-time tuner with pitch detection.
  • Melody Mate - In-browser generative MIDI workstation and melodic sketchpad using rule-based music theory heuristics and Web Audio API.
  • Ocarina Simulator (⭐0) - A playable 3D ocarina with sampled and synthesized voices, breath-controlled dynamics from the microphone and song recognition. Live demo.
  • Klaviero - Falling-notes piano game for MIDI keyboards, built on Web MIDI and Web Audio (Tone.js), with in-browser audio to MIDI.
  • psoup noise machine - Free generative noise machine in the browser: brown, pink and white noise computed live with the Web Audio API, tuned by the moon and the day's earthquakes.
  • seance - Sample workbench on the Web Audio API: spectrogram, drum stem separation, hit-based slicing and BS.1770-4 loudness, all in the browser.

Resources / Tutorials

  • Music Theory for Programmers - Music theory derived from scratch in JavaScript, with runnable Web Audio examples.

Manufacturers

    • Specification dataset (⭐0)

Visual programming

Social Media

Games / YouTube Playables

Tools / ML Kit

Content expires after 15 days by default (up to 30).

AI / Voxel Editors

AI / Diagnostics

entry.content:
1. Awesome Mysql

Binlog-Replication

  • dbtrail (⭐64) - Analytical replica of MySQL: keeps tables as Parquet files fed from the binlog, queried with DuckDB

2. Awesome Quant

Market Data & Data Sources

  • alphai-tui (⭐77) - Rust TUI - Terminal stock dashboard with keyless quotes, candlestick charts and portfolio tracking, plus optional news and SEC filing views powered by the AlphAI API.
  • prop-firm-rules (⭐1) - Python JavaScript Data - Sourced, dated dataset of prop-trading-firm daily-loss and max-drawdown rules (static and trailing, lock levels, reset times) for 9 firms and 13 programs, with a zero-dependency JS/Python drawdown calculator.
  • canli-pit-lake (⭐0) - Python DuckDB Parquet - Point-in-time market-data lake where every read takes an explicit as-of, corporate actions filter on when they became knowable, and delisted names are kept.
  • Gloomberb (⭐2.5k) - TypeScript Bun - Open-source finance terminal for quotes, charts, news, filings and portfolios, as a terminal UI, desktop app and web app.
  • Fonrex - Python Docker REST - Self-hosted financial data API for European and US markets: prices per listing, cross-checked fundamentals from 18 sources, DCF valuation and Fama/French factors in your own PostgreSQL. GitHub (⭐1)
  • Seiche (⭐1) - Python REST MCP - Money-market and dollar-funding research with public-source collectors, historical observations, separate release and retrieval clocks, and explicit coverage gaps.
  • CNEquity (⭐730) - Python MCP A-shares - Self-hosted China A-share data lake that keeps 55 datasets (prices, financials, capital flows, corporate events, futures and options) in local Parquet with incremental updates, point-in-time queries, delisted-stock retention, DuckDB SQL and a read-only MCP server.
  • yfinance-ir (⭐2) - Python - yfinance-shaped market data for Iranian markets: TSETMC equities, ETFs, indices and option chains, Codal financial statements, TGJU FX and gold, SCI CPI and Iranian crypto exchanges.
  • ws-wire-audit (⭐0) - Python - WebSocket wire-level measurement tool for exchange market-data feeds: frame and control-frame accounting, payload-vs-wire byte ratios, compression negotiation checks, and a documented API-contract audit.
  • edgar-full-text-search-examples (⭐0) - Python SEC EDGAR - Stdlib-only EDGAR full-text search to CSV that splits date ranges to get past the 10,000-result cap.
  • ninjatrader-to-parquet (⭐10) - Python - NinjaTrader 8 .ncd tick and minute history files to Parquet without NinjaTrader running; row-exact against NinjaTrader's own export, incremental re-runs.

Financial Instruments & Pricing

  • vanna (⭐2) - Python - Black-Scholes and CRR-binomial options pricing with Greek-attributed backtest P&L, decomposing each trade into delta, gamma, theta, vega, vanna, and volga via a second-order Taylor expansion.
  • stochPathSim (⭐15) - Python - Stochastic path simulation (Heston, rough Bergomi, Kou, curve-fitted Hull-White and G2++, CIR, commodity and credit models) with Monte Carlo pricing, exposure/CVA, risk-factor backtesting and a model-validation lab producing interactive Plotly HTML reports.
  • CustomDerivative - R - Black-Scholes-Merton pricing, Monte Carlo with antithetic and control variates and confidence intervals, path-dependent payoffs and finite-difference Greeks. GitHub (⭐2)
  • stochastic-rs - Rust Python - Quantitative finance library with 130+ stochastic processes, option pricing and calibration, volatility surfaces and copulas, SIMD/GPU accelerated with Python bindings. GitHub (⭐194)

Technical Indicators

  • Repaint Check (⭐0) - Pine - Records an EMA-cross signal during realtime bars and marks signals absent at the confirmed close.
  • yfinance-ta-patterns (⭐1) - Python - Candlestick and chart pattern recognition library for Yahoo Finance OHLCV market data.
  • technical-indicators (⭐0) - TypeScript - Dependency-free technical indicators (RSI, MACD, Bollinger, ATR, ADX, Ichimoku, SuperTrend…) with hand-verifiable tests, open datasets with provenance and reproducible behaviour reports.
  • gamma-seed (⭐2) - Python Pine Options - Daily dealer-gamma levels (gamma flip, call and put walls, max pain, expected move) for DAX, Nasdaq, Dow and gold, computed from options open interest (Eurex ODAX for the DAX, ETF proxies for the US) and written into a TradingView Pine v6 indicator; the method is documented in open studies on the author's site. Website

Trading & Backtesting

  • QuantDinger (⭐13k) - Python - Self-hosted platform for AI-assisted Python strategy development, backtesting, and paper and live trading across crypto exchanges and traditional brokers.
  • ALPHAC (⭐1) - Python - Cross-asset research and paper-trading engine with point-in-time data, walk-forward validation, multiple-testing accounting and a published forward record.
  • trading-research-agents (⭐36) - Python MCP - Autonomous trading system for crypto linear perpetuals in which language models only propose and deterministic rules decide: code computes every figure, prices the full round trip before an order exists, sizes from the operator's risk at the stop, keeps exits at the exchange, and records each cycle with a per-file SHA-256 that can be re-verified.
  • Desic Terminal (⭐33) - Rust TypeScript - MIT-licensed desktop terminal for OKX USDT perpetuals that pairs live discretionary trading with systematic research: realtime WebSocket market data, 24 indicators, a market-wide radar, AI assistants with typed wake conditions, and a bundled Python runtime for 1-minute backtests. Permission modes (advisor / copilot / limited_auto) are enforced by the runtime rather than by the prompt, and demo and live credentials are isolated.
  • Evidence Deflator (⭐0) - Python MCP - Checks how much of an LLM trading backtest falls on or before the model's training cutoff and how many clean months a claimed Sharpe needs once the number of attempts is counted, with an MCP server and an evidence-adjusted leaderboard of public AI trading competitions.
  • OpenBacktesting (⭐6) - Python - Historical single-asset backtesting with pandas-based statistics, technical indicators, and grid or SAMBO parameter optimization.
  • AlphaFinch (⭐2) - Python LLM - AlphaEvolve-style search in which an LLM invents and evolves trading strategies as Python code, judged on sealed holdouts and a pre-registered multi-market exam whose bar corrects for every attempt.
  • canli-backtest (⭐0) - Python - Backtester that raises on look-ahead (decide at close, fill at next open), replays funding and corporate actions point-in-time, and reports deflated Sharpe against the full trial count.
  • tilt-check (⭐0) - Python TabPFN Gemma - Pre-trade check and written audit from your own NinjaTrader trade history: sessions in market time, first trades of the day, re-entries after a loss, exit replay on minute bars, and written rules checked against the chart without look-ahead; never places orders.
  • Optra (⭐24) - C++ Python - Options trading system: one event-driven engine for backtesting and live trading on Interactive Brokers, with pricing, volatility and risk research tools.
  • Sharpen (⭐8) - Python - Open-source agentic-AI quant strategy builder that tries to disprove a strategy before it ships, including Crucible, an alpha-miner (Apache-2.0).
  • backtest-audit-kit (⭐0) - Python - Dependency-free audit toolkit for backtests (no numpy/pandas): detects look-ahead, checks cash/position ledger conservation, flags fee and funding double-counting, and mutation-tests your own suite for blind spots.
  • Lumina Capital (⭐4) - Python - Autonomous multi-agent quantitative hedge fund engine powered by LangGraph, Qlib Alpha158, and Google TimesFM.
  • TokIO (⭐4) - Python Pine Script - Backtest significance checker with published false-positive rates: dependence-robust tests corrected for every variant tried (Romano-Wolf), deflated and probabilistic Sharpe ratios, probability of backtest overfitting, breakeven costs and a one-bar lookahead check, taking vectorbt portfolios, backtesting.py results and TradingView trade exports directly.
  • perpbrain-sdk - TypeScript MCP - Hyperliquid perpetuals order-book fill simulator with fee, slippage and owner-limit checks, an execution-cost breakdown, and receipt verification that re-derives result hashes from the inputs.
  • LR-AutoInvest (⭐0) - Python CLI - Offline daily-bar paper accounts with idempotent CSV updates, price-history revision checks, configurable trading costs, and explainable rebalance plans.
  • matching-engine - Rust - Single-node spot order matching with price-time priority, fixed-point prices and quantities, and optional write-ahead-log recovery. GitHub (⭐1)
  • tradefloor (⭐0) - Python Rust - Generates simulated stock markets for testing trading strategies and AI agents, with a limit order book per company and an economy underneath, so orders fill against the book and move prices, and any run can be forked or replayed exactly.
  • tradingview-mcp (⭐5.1k) - Python MCP - MCP server that gives AI assistants screeners, multi-timeframe technical analysis and walk-forward backtests for stocks, crypto, forex and futures across global exchanges.
  • IBKR-Telegram (⭐2) - Python Telegram - Self-hosted Telegram bot for Interactive Brokers that runs next to IB Gateway: position snapshots and P&L tracking, plus option orders from chat commands or webhook signals, each confirmed in Telegram before it is sent, with market-hours, duplicate-signal and position-limit checks on webhook signals.
  • nt8-mcp (⭐24) - C# Python MCP - MCP server and NinjaTrader 8 AddOn that give an AI coding assistant a build loop for NinjaScript: offline and in-platform compile with structured errors, chart and log reads, headless backtests, optimization and walk-forward; read-only by default.

Portfolio Optimization & Risk Analysis

  • portfolio-risk-lab (⭐3) - Python - Uncertainty-aware portfolio optimization: compare covariance estimates, test allocations across risk scenarios, and see the cost of tighter constraints.
  • dca-ladder-calculator (⭐0) - JavaScript Crypto - Zero-dependency calculator for DCA order ladders on crypto perpetual futures that gives the average entry, take-profit, break-even and liquidation price (isolated or cross margin) after every order.
  • Deadlatch (⭐0) - Python MCP - Local, advisory-only pre-trade risk gate for trading agents with 12 deterministic fail-closed rules and a local audit log.
  • stochastly-calculators (⭐0) - TypeScript - Tested implementations of the probabilistic and deflated Sharpe ratios, minimum track record length, probability of backtest overfitting (CSCV) and a seeded prop-firm challenge simulator, each folder giving the formula and its source paper.
  • position-sizing-data (⭐1) - Data - Reference data and worked arithmetic for position sizing across forex, stocks and crypto futures: contract specifications (pip size, contract size, minimum step) for 131 instruments, pip value and 20-pip loss by lot size, losing-streak equity decay and drawdown-recovery tables, plus the risk-to-units formulas with two worked examples.

Time Series Analysis

  • NoiseFloor (⭐0) - Python MCP - Offline financial time-series diagnostics, correlation spectra, change detection, and forecast evaluation with explicit coverage and input-data rights checks.

Prediction Markets

  • oracle3 (⭐476) - Python MCP - Trading engine and MCP server for prediction markets with fee-aware no-arbitrage checks across related event contracts, statistical arbitrage, and live or paper execution on Kalshi, Polymarket, and Solana.
  • OpenThomas (⭐24) - Python MCP - Autonomous weather-market trading agent for Kalshi and Polymarket that learns per-station forecast bias from leak-free hindcasts and sizes positions with fractional Kelly under hard risk limits.
  • pm-hftbacktest (⭐125) - Rust Python - High-frequency trading and market-making backtesting for Polymarket, written in Rust, with queue position, latency and maker/taker fee models applied to tick-level L2 order book and trade data.

Visualization

  • Flowdepth (⭐18) - Rust Desktop - Open-source crypto order-flow terminal with footprint charts, historical L2 liquidity heatmaps, volume bubbles, CVD, and BTC/ETH/SOL options GEX analytics.
  • Kandle - TypeScript MCP - Browser charting app for crypto, stocks and forex with indicators, a scripting language with strategy backtests, alerts, bar replay and an MCP server for AI agents. GitHub (⭐0)
  • OpenKline - TypeScript - Canvas-based OHLCV charting engine with technical indicators, drawing tools, and streaming-data support. GitHub (⭐1)

Quant Research Environments

  • AxonX (⭐5) - Python MCP - Agent-native quantitative research harness with plugin-based tasks for data processing, factor analysis, model training, and backtesting, traceable artifacts, and CLI and web interfaces.
  • thesis-ci (⭐1) - Python CLI YAML - Linter and CI for written investment theses that fails a number without a filing citation, freezes test thresholds once results are out, and Brier-scores forecasts.
  • easy-stock (⭐1.5k) - Go React A-shares - Local-first AI research workbench for China A-shares: unified market overview, theme radar, limit-up ladder and sentiment-cycle analysis, AI stock reports, portfolio inspection, and agent-based collection of post-market commentary with evidence tracing.
  • AlphaLattice (⭐1) - Python Claude Code Codex - Local research workbench that a coding agent drives from one sentence: dated US large-cap research positions bounded by each date's information cutoff, SEC-filing evidence review, and an investment committee that changes no numbers.
  • SmartMoney-Cub (⭐27) - Python LLM - Local-first, agent-agnostic trading journal and review harness that freezes point-in-time run envelopes and evidence packs, replays them deterministically, and evaluates rule candidates against a frozen 240-case finance benchmark, with no order or broker access.

Reproducing Works, Training & Books

  • cfa-frm-formula-sheets (⭐0) - Training Data - Machine-readable CFA Level I/II and FRM Part I formula reference in LaTeX and JSON/CSV with variable definitions and official topic weights.
  • EPSILON - Python - Open-source backtesting simulator with a 25-minute Assumption Clinic worksheet that teaches students to inspect backtest assumptions using published failed cases. GitHub (⭐204)
